name: Convex Grid Topological Visibility Sorting
definition: An O(n) visibility sorting algorithm for a convex grid of convex cells, based on pairwise ordering relations between cells sharing a common face.
summary: Convex Grid Topological Visibility Sorting is an O(n) algorithm that determines back-to-front rendering order for convex grids by constructing a directed occlusion graph and performing a topological sort.
